Every arm in this family shares the exit 'close crosses_below swing_low(20)' and the fixed brackets (stop 0.12, no take-profit, 150-day hold cap, 3 slots at 0.25 each); the ONLY thing that varies within the family is the entry expression. the family's persona (Creator E / creator-e) pre-registered wick rejection at prior support with full-body candle confirmation as the one daily-bar principle from his method not yet tested here, and pre-registered that it loses in range-bound consolidation (PERSONA-DISCUSSION-2026-09-09.md section 3). This is a TREATMENT: the control's entry with one confirmation term added (intrabar structure, a full-body candle, or a distance-past-the-level confirmation). A confirmation term can only REDUCE firings relative to its own control, so this arm takes fewer trades and carries lower exposure -- which is exactly why the metric is exposure-adjusted excess and not raw return. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement. Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion by the r21 amendment; this is a measurement study, report only. Not investment advice.
